messages:
Maya: Quick proposal 10-day "integrator sprint" to land a LangChain + LlamaIndex adapter for our gateway + a minimal marketplace listing. Outcome: adapter repo, listing draft, SI demo checklist. Who can volunteer?
Devon: I can drive the adapter manifest and CI smoke tests. Will need approved container spec for marketplace.
Ibrahim: Runtime note 1: must support streaming and function/tool call shim for LangChain agents. Also add a compatibility flag for quantized models.
Sana: SI/demos here. We'll keep demo focused: SSO + VPC peering + failover. Need a sanitized dataset. Can Brightline SI provide one?
MarketplaceBot: Action created: MARKETPLACE-461 "LangChain adapter onramp" assigned to Maya. Due 2026-05-12.
Kai: Partnerships ops 1: I'll request co-marketing approval from the HW partner and propose an embargo window. Also confirm logo usage rules.
Maya: Timeline: Day 1-3 adapter scaffold + manifest; Day 4-6 perf smoke + docs; Day 7-9 marketplace listing + legal; Day 10 dry-run demo. Daily 10-min sync at 11:00 PT.
Devon: Adding example curl to docs and a tiny React sample. Pushing initial skeleton to GH: https://github.com/redwood-inference/langchain-adapter/pull/2
Ibrahim: I'll run a perf baseline on LlamaIndex flows and post numbers to the repo CI by tomorrow EOD.
Sana: I'll draft a 6-step SI playbook and include rollback steps for capacity outages.
Kai: Noted risks: marketplace review latency, partner legal signoff, and runtime kernel signing delays. I'll log these on the ticket.
Maya: Owners confirmed: Maya (program), Devon (adapter), Ibrahim (runtime perf), Sana (SI), Kai (partner ops). Thanks, team 1. We'll kick off Monday 09:30 PT.
